messages:
anna (support): FYI - Acme (acct: acme-prod) opened an escalation a few mins ago. p95 for their /generate calls jumped ~3x around 02:50 UTC, plus intermittent 401s and duplicate billing events. They're very unhappy. Posting sampled logs and a repro.
anna (support): ```
[2026-03-16T02:51:12Z] ERROR request_id=abc123 backend=redwood-host-12 status=502 latency=512ms route=/v1/generate
[2026-03-16T02:51:13Z] WARN auth token_refresh=failed user=acme svc_auth=401
[2026-03-16T02:51:17Z] INFO billing webhook id=wh_987 send=retry status=500
``` 
jamie (eng-oncall): thx anna. I'm seeing matching traces in traces.prod.usw2. p95 for the route jumped from ~120ms -> ~420-600ms starting ~02:45. Any deploys/rollouts then?
deploy-bot: kernel-update/2026-03-16 completed on cluster-usw2 at 02:44 UTC by infra/auto-rollout
ben (infra): that kernel-update pushed a host kernel + nvidia-driver bundle onto the cluster. We also rolled driver 535.24 -> 536.01 on the same window (automated chain). Could be driver+kernel interaction with NVMe path.
raj (runtime): interesting — our serving traces show sharp increase in nvme io_wait on nodes serving kv-cache. KV cache miss tail increased a lot. I can paste iostat and dmesg snippets.
raj (runtime): ```
# iostat -x 1 3
avg-cpu:  %user   %nice %system %iowait  %steal   %idle
           12.4     0.0    18.1    68.9     0.0     0.6
Device:         rrqm/s wrqm/s   r/s   w/s  rkB/s  wkB/s aveq-sz  await svctm  %util
nvme0n1         0.00  120.00  340.0  12.0 15000  600  45.10   128.4  0.29  98.6
```
maria (sre): %util 98.6 on nvme0n1 under small random reads is bad. Could explain p95 p99. We saw similar patterns when a driver changed IO submission batching last year.
ben (infra): agree. And the billing duplicates are likely caused by transient 5xx from our webhook gateway — retry logic fired multiple times. auth 401s might be a separate token refresh edge when backend latency exceeds expiry window.
anna (support): customer provided a repro curl they run from their pipeline. They said the spikes are reproducible.
anna (support): ```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACME_KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate -o /tmp/out -w "%{time_total}s"
# repeat 50 times parallel
``` 
jamie (eng-oncall): can we do two quick mitigations: 1) route Acme traffic to the dedicated pool 'ded-legacy-4' (no kernel/driver change yet) 2) pause billing webhook deliveries for Acme (so they stop seeing duplicates)
ben (infra): I can add a routing rule and set a host filter to move traffic now. Will kick off canary rollback of driver on a small set of nodes to confirm.
maria (sre): I'll open a short-lived throttle on webhook retries for that account and flag billing team to inspect for duplicate invoices. @billing-bot can you suspend webhook deliveries for account acme-prod until we ack?
billing-bot: acknowledged. Paused webhook deliveries for account acme-prod. Any queued events will be held for 1h.
raj (runtime): repro on a node in ded-legacy-4 shows stable p95 (~130ms). I'll start a parallel load test hitting nodes with new driver/kernel combo to capture perf counters.
raj (runtime): ```
# run every 100ms, 50 threads
wrk -t50 -c200 -d120s --latency 'https://internal-gw.usw2/v1/generate'
# collect perf counters: nvmetop, iostat, nvme-cli telemetry
``` 
ben (infra): started rollback canary on 4 nodes -> rolling back nvidia-driver -> 535.24. Expect those nodes to be back in 4-6m.
deploy-bot: rollback-driver/535.24 -> applied to nodes: host-042, host-087, host-091, host-108
maria (sre): early numbers: canary nodes p95 back to ~140ms, iowait drops to single digits. Looks correlated.
anna (support): Acme confirmed lower latency after being manually routed to ded-legacy-4. They're still worried about billing and want root cause.
jamie (eng-oncall): action items: - infra to finish rollback and hold driver rollout - runtime to run perf counters across full fleet and create timeline - billing/support to reconcile duplicated billing events and contacts - SRE to create postmortem and next steps (fwk: pin drivers until QA)
ben (infra): rolling back remaining rollout and adding a stricter canary gating for driver upgrades. Also adding nvme qdepth monitoring and automatic throttling when %util > 85%.
maria (sre): creating incident on-call doc and will schedule a postmortem review with kernel/driver vendors. I'll add recommended mitigations: increased KV cache TTLs, disable aggressive submission batching in runtime for affected hw, and temporary routing preferences per-customer.
anna (support): customer's billing team will share affected invoice IDs. I'll attach when they send. For now Acme is satisfied with the routing rollback but wants final RCA + compensation plan.
jamie (eng-oncall): thanks everyone. If we have stable rollback results in 30m, we'll start a customer-facing post with timeline and temporary credit offer. I'll update incident channel.
sre-bot: incident note created: INC-2026-3311 | p95 regression affecting Acme after driver/kernel upgrade. Mitigations: traffic routing, driver rollback, webhook pause. Owners: infra/ben, runtime/raj, billing/anna.
